source_delta: Two product-only changes: native UILabel rendering of exact entryScope copy, and explicit Clear-triggered guarded post-layout return to existing input anchor.

english_evidence.finding: Original node crop includes fixed Clear and off-window padding. This does not establish a foreground/background color defect. Existing UILabel wrapper is a bounded real-rendering experiment, not an inferred native pass.

arabic_evidence.finding: After actual Clear, contracted content remained wholly above the viewport. Frozen Clear had no explicit scroll recovery when the editor was unfocused.

review_points: entryScope exact localized copy and .subheadline retained; existing UILabel provides natural alignment, explicit RTL semantic direction and accessibilityLanguage, Dynamic Type, wrapping and visible semantic label/systemGroupedBackground surface.
No hidden replacement, duplicate text, accessibility frame override, text shrink, audit filter, caught audit retry or test waiver introduced.
Clear resets focus, pending Screen reveal, reading anchor and session, then issues a new explicit event. Ordinary reading, edits and passive result changes do not issue this event.
The deferred handler verifies the same Clear request and empty/no-result state, now also verifies the editor has not regained focus, before scrolling the actual surviving input anchor.

Both native test files are byte-identical at this review; all existing helpers, top-level journeys and uncaught audits remain. A later exact-source SHA binding/QA identity update must be checked separately.

review_finding_closed.issue: A deferred Clear reveal could compete with newly acquired focus on an empty editor.
review_finding_closed.owner_fix: Added !ingredientEditorFocused to the deferred action guard.

limits: No Swift compile, test, simulator or native command executed by this reviewer.
Next-main-cycle layout/keyboard completion and tall native text audit behavior require the same native journeys to pass.
No claim of R8 release, full native pass or store acceptance.
